description: Bestiary Points approximate Structured Combat cost and are useful as a baseline for Narrative encounters. Creature type does not automatically grant faction allegiance; the army's list-building and scenario rules establish when creatures may join a faction.
notes: Companion Point Values contribute separately to their bonded PC's battlefield value, including both animals when the Tier 4 Talent grants a second one.
The large-monster increases in v5 are provisional: Wyvern 295 (Bite A6), Roc 315 (Talons A6), Chimera 330 (Claws and Fangs A5), Cave Wurm 360 (Maw A6), Young Dragon 445 (Claws A7).
Hydra 365 gains W15 and up to A10 while fully healthy but degrades with Damage. Kraken 700 is a four-Model Unit (Body W15 + three Tentacles W3).
Fire-sensitive Regeneration stops only after unsaved Fire Damage. Fire, Frost, Lightning, Radiant, Nature remain secondary Attack descriptors, not new saves.
New playtest-tier bosses: Elder Treant 475, Sea Serpent 530, Adult Dragon 675. All creature Points are provisional and must be tested against 3–4 PC parties, accounting for activation economy.
crossCheck: Profile counts 9/14/10/17/15 are drawn from structured JSON, including 17 large monster entries and excluding the Elder Wurm configured variant, which is an upgrade of Cave Wurm.
